supporting_observations.claim: The alerted account tmp.rwong was created at 13:42:35 UTC by emma.stone, using the logon session associated with her network logon from WS-ESTONE-01.
The account name follows the documented tmp.<name> convention for temporary accounts, and the observed group addition was to Temp-Staff.
The creator is the help desk account emma.stone, which the supplied environment context says is permitted to create domain accounts.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs were not collected from 13:25 to 14:00 UTC. This limits visibility into proxy activity during that interval but does not remove the available domain account creation and group-change records.
claims_not_established: The records do not establish the business request or approval that prompted creation of tmp.rwong.
The available records do not establish whether tmp.rwong was later used or whether it had any group memberships beyond the observed Temp-Staff addition.
unrelated_findings: Separate review recommended: emma.stone launched SSH from WS-ESTONE-01 to PROXY-PIN-01, although remote administration is documented as being performed only from WS-RPATEL-01. The records show the process and connection, but not what occurred on the remote host. (T088-00069, T088-00071, T088-00075)

Separate review recommended: emma.stone initiated RDP sessions from WS-ESTONE-01 to DC-PIN-01 and FILE-PIN-01, rather than using the documented remote-administration workstation. (T088-00076, T088-00078, T088-00079, T088-00091, T088-00096, T088-00097)

Separate review recommended: Google Drive File Stream and Slack were launched on WS-ESTONE-01; the inventory approves Microsoft 365/OneDrive and does not list these services as approved. (T088-00008, T088-00010, T088-00087, T088-00088)
